scripts.prod:rebuild: docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
scripts.prod:deploy: git pull --ff-only && npm run prod:up && npm run migrate && npm run optimize && npm run queue:restart
scripts.prod:health: docker compose exec app php artisan about --only=environment,drivers
scripts.logs:laravel: docker compose exec app tail -f storage/logs/laravel.log
scripts.key:generate: docker compose exec app sh -c 'php artisan key:generate --force --ansi && grep "^APP_KEY=" .env | cut -d= -f2- > storage/app/.app_key && chown www-data:www-data storage/app/.app_key' && npm run prod:restart
scripts.key:show: docker compose exec app sh -c 'cat storage/app/.app_key'
scripts.artisan: docker compose exec app php artisan
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec app php artisan migrate --force --ansi
scripts.migrate:status: docker compose exec app php artisan migrate:status
scripts.migrate:rollback: docker compose exec app php artisan migrate:rollback --force --ansi
scripts.seed: docker compose exec app php artisan db:seed --force --ansi
scripts.db:shell: docker compose exec db psql -U laravel -d laravel
scripts.db:backup: sh -c 'mkdir -p backups && docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U laravel laravel > backups/db-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql && ls -lh backups | tail -1'
scripts.optimize: docker compose exec app php artisan optimize --ansi
scripts.optimize:clear: docker compose exec app php artisan optimize:clear --ansi
scripts.cache:clear: docker compose exec app php artisan cache:clear --ansi
scripts.storage:link: docker compose exec app php artisan storage:link --ansi
scripts.assets:build: docker compose exec app npm run build
scripts.orchid:publish: docker compose exec app php artisan orchid:publish --ansi
scripts.orchid:admin: docker compose exec app php artisan orchid:admin
scripts.queue:restart: docker compose exec app php artisan queue:restart --ansi
scripts.queue:failed: docker compose exec app php artisan queue:failed
scripts.queue:retry: docker compose exec app php artisan queue:retry all
scripts.search:import: docker compose exec app sh -c 'php artisan scout:import "App\\Models\\Ride" && php artisan scout:import "App\\Models\\Sale"'
scripts.search:flush: docker compose exec app sh -c 'php artisan scout:flush "App\\Models\\Ride" && php artisan scout:flush "App\\Models\\Sale"'
scripts.maintenance:on: docker compose exec app php artisan down --render=errors::503
scripts.maintenance:off: docker compose exec app php artisan up
scripts.perms:fix: docker compose exec app sh -c 'chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache && chmod -R 775 storage bootstrap/cache'
